issues.description: The exercise asks students to implement a constructor to initialize all attributes (see problem statement and UML). The solution defines the constructor with package-private visibility (no access modifier) while other methods are public. This can be confusing because the UML shows public members and students are likely to implement a public constructor; moreover, a non-public constructor can prevent instantiation from other packages (for example, by external tests or usage), causing unexpected accessibility issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public to match the expected public API implied by the UML and to avoid accessibility surprises. Change the declaration to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... }
